arguments.query: Deployment failed, try again later while polling deployment status

calls.evidence: total_count 5: #406 open 'Intermittent Deploy Failures starting 2026-01-13'; #418 open 'Error: Deployment failed, try again later.'; #372 closed; #166 closed; #163 closed
Open, 19 comments, 10 +1, created 2026-05-24, updated 2026-07-06, no closing PR. Log: 'Getting Pages deployment status... Error: Deployment failed, try again later.'

Reports from v4 and v5 and from both Actions and branch sources. Artifact found and deployment created before the failure. Many reports 2026-07-02..07-06. Several resolved by retry or by themselves. Anecdotal workarounds: cancel-in-progress true, PUT /pages to re-apply settings, POST /pages/builds. In-place re-runs can cause a multiple-artifact error. No maintainer response seen.
Open, created 2026-01-14, updated 2026-11-06. Polling stuck at 'syncing_files' and then 'Error: Deployment failed, try again later.' Another attempt timed out at 'deployment_queued'.
2 comments (2026-08-06): stuck at deployment_queued after a source migration from branch to Actions; a stale locked deployment was cancelled via the API and the next deployment still stayed queued.
src/internal/deployment.js finalErrorStatus maps deployment_failed to 'Deployment failed, try again later.'; deployment_content_failed is a separate artifact error (hard links, symlinks, 10GB limit).

arguments.query: GitHub Docs: using custom workflows with GitHub Pages, deploy-pages permissions pages: write id-token: write and github-pages environment

calls.evidence: docs.github.com custom workflows page: deploy job needs pages: write and id-token: write, needs: build, environment github-pages; artifact must be gzip with a single tar under 10GB and no symlinks or hard links. The deploy-pages README confirms these and the OIDC rationale.
Truncated before the deployment-status section. Returned the GET /pages schema (build_type, source, status, https_certificate).

arguments.query: GitHub Docs troubleshooting GitHub Pages workflow deployment errors and Pages publishing source configuration

calls.evidence: Configuring a publishing source: branch vs GitHub Actions; branch sites also deploy through an Actions run; GITHUB_TOKEN pushes do not trigger Pages builds; the github-pages environment is created automatically.

GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pages/deployments/{pages_deployment_id} (ID or commit SHA) returns status enum: deployment_in_progress, syncing_files, finished_file_sync, updating_pages, purging_cdn, deployment_cancelled, deployment_failed, deployment_content_failed, deployment_attempt_error, deployment_lost, succeed. Also documents the cancel, builds, and health endpoints.
